name: io.github.shieldfive/mcp
title: ShieldFive
description: Tidy your E2E-encrypted ShieldFive vault and local folders. Decrypts locally; revocable access.

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDFIVE_GRANT
environmentVariables.description: Connection string from ShieldFive → Settings → AI assistants. Optional: `npx @shieldfive/mcp login` stores it in the OS keychain instead.

environmentVariables.name: SHIELDFIVE_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Local directories the local tools may use, separated by the platform path separator. Optional.
